references.text: The same age requirement for the Levites' service is mentioned earlier in the chapter, from thirty to fifty years.
Repeats the age requirement for the Gershonites' service at the tent of meeting.
The same age requirement is repeated for Merari's sons in their service.
Describes the years of service for the Levites, from twenty-five years and upward, with retirement at fifty years.
David counts the Levites from thirty years and upward for service.
David's change of the service age for the Levites to twenty years, with reference to the original arrangement.
Mentions the Levites' service at the tabernacle under the leadership of Ithamar.
